title: Biography Flash: Warren Buffett Steps Back, Berkshire Bets Big on Housing
summary: In the past few days, Warren Buffett’s most consequential story has been his formal retreat from Berkshire Hathaway. According to Berkshire’s September 18 company announcement, Buffett is now chairman emeritus and remains a director, while his son Howard Buffett has become non executive chairman and Greg Abel continues as chief executive. The change ends more than six decades of Warren Buffett serving as Berkshire’s chairman, making it one of the defining final chapters of his business biography.
